title: Serving Others
definition: Serving others is the Christlike practice of using one's strength, gifts, time, and resources for the good of others.
summary: Believers serve others because Christ first served them.
christFocus: Jesus came not to be served but to serve, giving His life as a ransom for many.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Serving others is central to Christian love. Believers do not use freedom for selfishness but through love serve one another. Service may be visible or hidden, large or small, but it matters to God.

Christ is the pattern of service. He humbled Himself, washed feet, bore burdens, and gave His life. Christian service follows His humility rather than seeking status.

Serving others builds up the Church, cares for the vulnerable, strengthens relationships, and displays the Gospel in action.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Self-centeredness can disguise itself as busyness, comfort, or even religious activity. Serving others matters because it trains believers to love in action, not words only.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Look for a practical burden you can help carry. Serve without demanding attention, and ask whether your gifts are being used for others or mainly for yourself.
